name: devbox
changelog:
v4: a native view for the xbin app (native.js): containers and SSH keys as tabs, swipe actions, a detail screen with the SSH command, the create forms as sheets
v3: response helpers come from the SDK (xbin.WriteJSON/WriteError); the container spec is a pure builder with a test
v2: declares its reader/writer roles under expose.roles (the backend always guarded with them; they are now grantable to other tiles)
v1: rootless-podman container-host tile with an SSH proxy into container shells
title: Devbox (containers + SSH)
description: Spin up rootless Podman containers as dev sandboxes and SSH straight into any of them — the container name is the SSH user (ssh -p<port> <name>@<host>). Manage containers and your authorized SSH keys from the tile. Needs the admin-only cap:containers grant, a net binding for container egress, and its SSH port published to a host port via ingress. A worked example of a container-host tile (docs/changes/2026-07-14-container-tiles.md).
